snippet_primary: "The main options are Gumroad - high fees and ugly design, solid system never had issues does most what I need · Lemon Squeezy - it was very popular until being acquired by stripe. Full of serious bugs, bad support. Lovely design, slightly better fees than Gumroad, but many hidden. Would still use over Gumroad just cause the Gumroad checkout design is so bad it loses sales imo"
